text:
Tyler: quick flag — our new CF Workers sample crashes in preview during auth signing: `ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined`. Also seeing `TypeError: request body stream closed` for some multipart POSTs.
Mei: ugh, Node globals leaking into edge bundles. Which bundler + target?
Tyler: rollup build, output ESM, no special aliases. target wasn't set to webworker.
Oscar: rollup defaults can still pull node:crypto via deps. For workers we usually alias `node:crypto` -> `./shims/crypto-web.js` and provide a tiny adapter around `globalThis.crypto.subtle`.
Rhea: also check any use of `setImmediate` or `process.nextTick` in the SDK core. CF Workers don't have those. We replaced uses with `queueMicrotask` or a microtask wrapper in the sample: `const asap = globalThis.setImmediate ?? (f=> queueMicrotask(f));`
build-bot: preview created: tyler/cf-worker-fix-5 — running tests. :repeat:
Mei: streaming note — Workers expose WHATWG ReadableStream; Node stream.Transform won't work. In the sample we added `readable-stream/web` or a tiny bridge: `nodeStreamToWeb(nodeReadable) -> new ReadableStream({ pull(ctrl) { ... } })`.
Tyler: tried `import { Buffer } from 'buffer'`, but still crash because a transitive package does `require('node:crypto')`. Could we use rollup `alias` plugin to replace `node:crypto` with `./shims/crypto-web.js`?
Oscar: yep. Also ensure `package.json` of sample has `type: "module"` and `wrangler.toml` `type = "esm"`—otherwise Wrangler will complain `Cannot use import statement outside a module`. Add that to README.
Rhea: typing FYI — consumers using TS `module: "ESNext"` saw weird `exports` resolution when bundling. We added an explicit `exports` field in the sample package to point at the built ESM file.
Tyler: CI shows 10/11 checks passed; streaming-smoke failing. stack: `TypeError: TransformStream is not constructible`. Could be a non-spec polyfill in the preview env.
Mei: file an issue with the preview id and stacktrace. Also leave a failing test that asserts the runtime uses webstreams instead of node streams so we don't regress.
Oscar: longer-term: propose SDK accept an opt-in `targetRuntime: 'node'|'webworker'` so code paths can avoid Node APIs when targeting webworkers. I'll draft the PR.
Tyler: plan: I'll push rollup alias + crypto shim + buffer shim, update README with wrangler/es module tips, add AbortController fallback for retry code, and keep the preview running until streaming green. Thanks folks. :raised_hands:
